channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Rare deadly pufferfish found on Dorset beach
item.description: A rare and deadly pufferfish has washed ashore on a beach in Dorset. Authorities have issued a warning to the public regarding the poisonous nature of the fish. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi implements anti-pollution measures as winter restrictions begin
item.description: Delhi authorities have announced five major restrictions to combat winter pollution, effective November 1. These measures include a directive for 50% of government employees to work from home and a ban on certain construction activities… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 6.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab causes deaths, damage across India
item.description: Cyclone Arnab has caused deaths and significant damage across several Indian states. In Andhra Pradesh, Chief Minister Naidu estimated losses at Rs 4600 crore and reported seven fatalities. Odisha experienced landslides and floods… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: US Southwest faces flooding risk from heavy rain and El Niño storms
item.description: The U.S. Southwest is facing an increased risk of flooding due to heavy rainfall. El Niño storms are contributing to these conditions, with reports of golf-ball-sized hail also occurring in the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Weather Updates for Siliguri and Uttar Pradesh
item.description: Weather forecasts indicate varying conditions for Siliguri and Uttar Pradesh. For Siliguri, updates are available on Air Quality Index (AQI), temperature, and rain. In Uttar Pradesh, the weather outlook suggests a possibility of sunshine… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Cyclone Murasu Approaches Andhra Coast; Bhutan GLOF Triggers Flood Alerts
item.description: Cyclone Murasu has formed over the Bay of Bengal and is approaching the Andhra Pradesh coast with winds up to 120 kmph, prompting alerts in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, with Telangana bracing for heavy rains and squally weather… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 16 · Right 5.

item.title: Andaman Sea Low Pressure Area to Intensify into Depression
item.description: A well-marked low-pressure area in the Andaman Sea is expected to intensify into a depression. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasts that it will reach the Andhra coast by November 2. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha Imposes Seven-Month Fishing Ban for Olive Ridley Turtle Protection
item.description: Odisha has implemented a seven-month ban on sea fishing along its coast to protect Olive Ridley turtles during their nesting season. The ban is in effect in areas identified as turtle congregation zones. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Protests Erupt Over Siang Dam Project in Arunachal Pradesh
item.description: Protests have emerged concerning the Siang dam project in Arunachal Pradesh. One protester detained in connection with the demonstrations has alleged sexual assault during their detention. Pawan Khera has criticized the Delhi Police… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nations Agree on Biodiversity Action, Funding Gap Remains
item.description: Countries participating in COP17 have agreed to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity. However, the agreement highlights a persistent shortfall in funding and concrete action needed to meet conservation goals. The negotiations also… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Air Pollution Worsens Amidst Diwali Preparations
item.description: Delhi's air quality has deteriorated significantly, prompting authorities to implement stricter measures as the Diwali festival approaches. The worsening pollution is not confined to Delhi, indicating a broader regional issue. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh braces for cyclone, CM Naidu promises modernization funds
item.description: Andhra Pradesh is preparing for another cyclone expected within 24 hours, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu canceled a visit to Delhi and directed officials to issue a bulletin on the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Odisha Coast Faces New Cyclonic Threat After Cyclone Arnab
item.description: Days after Cyclone Arnab, the coast of Odisha is facing a new cyclonic threat. This fresh storm raises concerns about potential flooding and crop damage in the region. Following Cyclone Arnab, the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Chemical Leak Vents in Toledo, Resident Describes Scene
item.description: A chemical leak was venting in Toledo, with one resident describing the scene as resembling a movie. The event occurred on October 21. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UAE Forecasts Five Days of Unsettled Weather
item.description: The United Arab Emirates is anticipating five days of unsettled weather, with forecasts indicating the possibility of more rain. This weather pattern is expected to bring a period of disruption. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Europe Heatwave Linked to 50,000 Deaths and Economic Loss
item.description: Europe's intense summer heatwave may have caused approximately 50,000 deaths and resulted in an economic loss of $18.9 billion, according to a report. The heatwave significantly impacted the continent's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Strong earthquake of magnitude 7.0 strikes Tibet
item.description: A powerful earthquake measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale struck Tibet. This is reported as the largest tremor recorded in the region in 30 days, with two earthquakes having been registered in that period. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Earthquakes Strike Pakistan, Afghanistan, and China
item.description: Earthquakes with magnitudes ranging from 4.1 to 4.9 struck Pakistan, Afghanistan, and China on Friday morning. The strongest tremor, measuring 4.9, was recorded in Pakistan. In Tibet, China, 16 deaths were reported due to the earthquake. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Amit Shah launches Rs 8,941 crore Yamuna cleaning project
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has launched projects worth Rs 8,941 crore aimed at cleaning the Yamuna river by 2029. He stated that making the Yamuna clean is a priority for the government and the BJP, attributing the river's current poor… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Scientists Warn 96% of Coral Reefs Face Collapse by 2075
item.description: Scientists have warned that 96% of the world's coral reef ecosystems are at critical risk of collapse by 2075, within the next 50 years. The primary drivers identified for this potential collapse are emissions and pollution. This… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Magnitude 7.0 Earthquake Strikes Tibet, Killing 16
item.description: A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Tibet, resulting in at least 16 deaths and 46 injuries. State media reported that over 300 houses collapsed, leaving hundreds homeless. The earthquake occurred within a span of approximately 40 minutes… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 10 · Right 1.

item.title: UN Report Warns of Accelerating Global Warming and Urgent Emission Cuts
item.description: A United Nations report indicates global temperatures are set to rise by 1.7-1.8 degrees Celsius, with a leading climate scientist stating global warming is accelerating. To avoid disastrously overshooting climate targets, the world must… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Chemical Tank Explodes in Ohio, Triggering Evacuations
item.description: A chemical tank exploded in Ohio, leading to mandatory evacuations and concerns about a potential secondary blast. A toxic chemical leak also occurred, blanketing the city in a mysterious haze. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Torrential Rain Causes Severe Flooding in Eastern Spain
item.description: Torrential rain has caused severe flooding in towns across eastern Spain, trapping residents and leading to widespread evacuations. More than 2,000 people have been evacuated from the region as the downpour batters the area. The heavy… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Super Typhoon Champi Becomes Strongest Storm of 2026, Heads for Taiwan
item.description: Super Typhoon Champi has become the strongest storm of 2026, with winds reaching 296 kmph. The typhoon, described as one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, was packing gusts of more than 227 kmh near its center as it… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Flesh-eating parasite found in Texas wildlife
item.description: The New World screwworm, a flesh-eating parasite, has been detected in U.S. wildlife for the first time in an elk in Pecos County, Texas. The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) confirmed the finding on Wednesday and has alerted hunters… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Warns El Niño Could Cause Global Economic Shocks
item.description: The United Nations has warned that the El Niño weather phenomenon could act as a 'wrecking ball,' causing widespread havoc across continents and triggering global economic shocks. The phenomenon is also predicted to cause a record rise in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Plan for 12-mile tunnel to stop sewage in Lake Windermere
item.description: A 12-mile tunnel is proposed to divert sewage away from Lake Windermere, England's largest lake, in a plan estimated to cost £3.7 billion. United Utilities, the Environment Agency, and local campaigners are involved in the proposal to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Tokyo and Osaka Hit Record High Temperatures Late in Year
item.description: Tokyo and Osaka have recorded their latest-ever days with temperatures exceeding 30 degrees Celsius. This marks a new record for the latest point in the year these cities have experienced such high temperatures. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bad Weather Disrupts Paragliding and Diverts Cruise Ship
item.description: Bad weather conditions have disrupted paragliding activities at Bir-Billing, despite a heavy tourist rush. Separately, adverse weather forced a Caribbean-bound cruise ship to divert its course to Halifax. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Report: US Climate Pollution Increases, Outlier Among G20
item.description: A United Nations report identifies the United States as an outlier among G20 nations due to a significant increase in its climate pollution. The Emissions Gap Report highlights the U.S. as a major contributor to greenhouse gas emissions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Monsoon Activity Expected in Parts of India, Clear Skies Elsewhere
item.description: Parts of Madhya Pradesh, including Gwalior-Chambal and Vindhya regions, are forecast to experience rain with thunder and lightning across 20 districts. In contrast, Bhopal and Indore are expected to have clear weather. Meanwhile, in Bihar… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 4.

item.title: Hurricane Trudy Intensifies to Category 3 Storm
item.description: Hurricane Trudy has strengthened to a Category 3 storm off the Pacific coast of Mexico. The storm is expected to intensify further in the coming days, with forecasts suggesting it could become one of the planet's strongest storms this… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal Flood Highlights Risks for Disaster Survivors
item.description: A devastating flood in Nepal has exposed the risks faced by disaster survivors, particularly those resettled in vulnerable areas. In Khalte village, Chheku Lama attempted to warn others to flee uphill as the floodwaters rose, but he and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Wildfire on Indonesia's Mount Bromo Kills Four
item.description: A wildfire on Mount Bromo in Indonesia's East Java province has resulted in the deaths of four people and severe burns for two others. The victims were reportedly battling the blaze when it intensified. Indonesia has stated it will accept… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Libya Floods Kill Two, Submerge Homes and Hospitals
item.description: Torrential rains caused severe flooding in Tripoli, Libya, resulting in two fatalities. The floods submerged cars, homes, and hospitals in the capital city. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Southern California Faces Fire Risk Amid Santa Ana Winds
item.description: Southern California is facing an emerging fire risk, particularly in Malibu, with evacuation orders issued due to a wildfire. The region is also under wildfire warnings, exacerbated by Santa Ana winds. Separately, California has ordered… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Sukhna Wetland in Chandigarh Designated Ramsar Site
item.description: Chandigarh's Sukhna Wetland has been designated a Ramsar site, increasing India's total number of such sites to 103. Uttar Pradesh's Sauj Jheel was also added to the global list. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Winter weather forecast predicts snow and rain for drought-stricken US states
item.description: The official winter weather forecast indicates that some drought-stricken regions in the United States may experience snow and rain. The forecast details the expected severity of the upcoming winter. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bald Eagle 'Jackie' Dies of Bird Flu in US
item.description: Jackie, a bald eagle from California who had gained internet fame, has died from highly pathogenic avian influenza. Bird flu has been circulating in bird populations across the United States. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
